title: What is Genius Farms Limited (GFL)?
content: Genius Farms Limited (GFL) is an IT-based software company that provides technology solutions for agriculture and other sectors. The company focuses on leveraging modern technologies to improve efficiency and innovation.

title: GFL?
content: GFL stands for Genius Farms Limited. It is an IT-based software company that provides technology solutions for agriculture and other sectors. The company focuses on leveraging modern technologies to improve efficiency and innovation.

title: What Does Genius Farms Limited (GFL) Do?
content: Genius Farms Limited works both within Bangladesh and abroad on a variety of activities, including software customization, mobile app development, brand promotion, AI integration, IoT and drone technology applications in agriculture, e-commerce solutions, production of learning documentaries, online and offline training programs, and agricultural supply chain services.

title: When Did Genius Farms Limited (GFL) Start Operations?
content: Genius Farms Limited (GFL) started its operations in 2020, marking its entry into the IT and agriculture technology sector.

title: Where is the Office of Genius Farms Limited (GFL)?
content: The office of Genius Farms Limited (GFL) is located at 572/K, Wasi Tower, ECB Chattar, Matikata, Dhaka-1206, Bangladesh.
